\section*{AI Tool Declaration}
\addcontentsline{toc}{section}{AI Tool Declaration}

We used two AI assistants during this project, under the course's
academic-integrity rules, and declare their use here.

\textbf{Anthropic's Claude} (Claude Code, an agentic coding assistant) was used
as a programming and writing assistant working under our direction: it drafted
and refactored Python code in \code{src/}, \code{deployment/} and \code{tests/}
from our specifications; helped locate and fix bugs in the data pipeline, the
training scripts and the Streamlit application; ran the regeneration scripts
whose outputs (\code{report/results/}, \code{report/stats\_phase3.txt}) are the
source of every number quoted here; typeset this report in \LaTeX{} and helped
build the slide deck from our outlines, results and the evaluators' feedback;
and cross-checked the manuscript and the slides against the result tables
before submission.

\textbf{OpenAI's ChatGPT} was used to generate and validate ideas, to improve
expression and to refine our writing.

\textbf{The revision after the presentation of 5 November 2026} used Claude
Code in the same role, at the team's direction: it proposed and drafted the
changes made in response to the feedback --- the revised sections and
appendices of this report and two new analysis scripts,
\code{src/customer\_view.py} and \code{src/slide\_provenance.py} --- and it
labelled the 175 held-out comments behind the complaint-topic precision check
(\code{customer\_topic\_labels.csv}, Appendix~\ref{app:customer}). Every number
the revision adds is read from a script output in \code{report/results/} or
\code{report/stats\_phase3.txt}; assertions in the new scripts require the earlier
results (the deployed models' test predictions, and the lists and values shown
on the slides) to be reproduced exactly, and
\code{src/slide\_provenance.py} checks every number on the slides against its
source (Appendix~\ref{app:provenance}). The revision adds no reference.

The choice of problems, the analysis design (the prediction moments, the
leakage regimes, the chronological split, the pre-registered success criteria
and selection rule), the interpretation of the results and the business
recommendations of the report as first submitted are the team's own, and for
that report we reviewed every AI-assisted piece of code and text, verified every
number against the underlying data by re-running the scripts, and checked every
reference against the publisher's record or DOI. We are responsible for the
content and quality of the submitted work.
